title: ADO backlog
description: Epic/Feature hierarchy consumed by Import-AdoBacklog.ps1 and Set-AdoBacklogOrder.ps1, and produced by Export-AdoBacklog.ps1. ADO is the source of truth; the JSON is generated. Work items are matched by exact System.Title, which is therefore the idempotency key and must be unique and stable across runs.

generatedFrom.description: Written by Export-AdoBacklog as '<organizationUrl>/<project>'. Informational only; ignored on import.

epics.description: Epics in backlog order. Array order = backlog order for Set-AdoBacklogOrder (top of file = top of backlog / lowest StackRank).

id.description: ADO work item id. Written by Export; ignored on import (matching is by title).

title.description: System.Title. The idempotency key: an epic with this exact title is reused, not recreated. Must be unique across the project.

tags.description: System.Tags, semicolon-separated (e.g. 'MVP; backend'). Applied on create only.

state.description: System.State. Written by Export; ignored on import.

description.description: System.Description (plain text on import; HTML is stripped to plain text on export). Applied on create only.

features.description: Child Features in backlog order within this epic.

id.description: ADO work item id. Written by Export; ignored on import (matching is by title).

title.description: System.Title. Idempotency key for the feature; must be unique across the project (matching is global by title, not scoped to the parent epic).

tags.description: System.Tags, semicolon-separated. Applied on create only.

state.description: System.State. Written by Export; ignored on import.
